synthesizedFacts.fact: Rooster comb injections, also known as hyaluronic acid injections, are used to treat osteoarthritis of the knee by supplementing the joint's natural lubricating fluid.
Hyaluronic acid for these injections was originally derived from rooster combs but is now often produced through bacterial fermentation.
Hyaluronic acid injections are FDA-approved for the treatment of knee osteoarthritis.
A pilot study showed that a natural extract of chicken combs with high hyaluronic acid content can improve pain relief and quality of life in knee osteoarthritis patients.
